name: exiled as useless, hidden skill proves strongest
description: A group throws the lead out as dead weight; the skill they mocked turns out to be the one that mattered, and the group falls apart without it.

name: humble job or weak skill outclasses the elite
description: A farmer, mechanic, servant or holder of the weakest skill solves what heroes and high ranks could not, by ordinary craft rather than a hidden power.

name: discarded lady is cherished by a powerful man
description: A woman is dropped by her fiance or family for someone flashier, then valued, and often doted on, by a higher-status man who sees what she is worth.

name: undervalued worker stops covering, the offender is exposed
description: Someone quietly fixing other people's failures is treated as unfair or useless; they stop, or simply follow the rule as written, and the offender's real level shows.

name: in-law or close friend's injustice gets its comeuppance
description: A mother-in-law, relative or friend treats the lead unfairly inside everyday family or friendship rules, and a concrete turn makes them pay for it.

name: everyday mystery with a chilling reveal
description: An ordinary routine (a delivery order, a shop, a habit) hides something wrong, and the story ends on the reveal.

name: relatable daily-life or dating comedy
description: Short comic situations from couples, school, work or family that the viewer recognises from their own life; no fantasy engine.

name: afterlife or other world run as a workplace
description: Death, hell or another world is an office with postings, forms and bosses, and the lead is a new hire there.

name: small kindness repaid by the powerful
description: The lead helps a stranger who looks unimportant; the stranger turns out to hold power and returns the favour at scale.

name: rescued stray is secretly a noble
description: An animal or nobody the lead takes in and cares for is a high-status person in disguise, who becomes devoted to them.
